t: Wisconsin Historical Society Press
s: Year after year, WHSP creates books that connect readers to their past, helping them understand their place in society and their role in protecting the environment. Two of the press' upcoming spring titles exemplify the mission of connecting the past and present -- and they perfectly capture the current interest in small farming and locally produced food. I find it very impressive that a publisher of history does such a great job of feeling the pulse of tomorrow. When we think of Wisconsin, we usually picture a lush, green field with black-and-white dairy cows grazing on it.
